content: This product is not guaranteed to be safe, effective, or suitable for your use. The information provided here is not personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Side Effects: Burning, stinging, or redness at the application site may occur. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. In rare cases, this medication may be absorbed through the skin and cause systemic side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are extremely rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before using minoxidil, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this product should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication can be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this product at room temperature, away from heat. This product is flammable. Keep it away from fire and avoid open flames after application until the medication has completely dried. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not ensure that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
